description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Header' for the streaming platform's frontend. It manages header elements including branding, search input, navigation links, and user authentication actions such as login, logout, and registration. The component interacts with routing, user authentication context, and performs search URL parameter updates.

methods.name: Header()
methods.description: React functional component rendering the site header with branding, search, and user controls.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles form submission for searching videos; updates URL parameters based on search query.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Performs user logout by calling API, clearing user context, and navigating to login page.
